pinned.model_note: Fixed for baseline AND all experiments (cost decision). Never varied between arms.
pinned.claude_code_cli_note: Pinned in ada/Dockerfile ARG CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION; matches installed CLI in this sandbox.

arms.A_reference: harbor claude-code agent (bare CLI, same model)
arms.B_treatment: ada bridge via eval/ada-agent/ adapter (same model)

task_subset.selection_rule: Diverse task types, biased toward tasks plausibly in haiku-4.5's measurable band (20-80%). Floor tasks (both arms = 0 across probe repeats) are dropped after the variance probe; replacements pulled from candidate_pool.
floor_tasks_dropped: sqlite-db-truncate (0/3 reference, 0/2 ada in probes) -> replaced by db-wal-recovery

repeats.k_note: MEASURED by variance probe (eval/variance-probe.md): mean cost CV=0.190 => k=(1.96*0.190/0.20)^2=3.46 => k=4. Duration CV=0.058 (negligible).

decision_rule.accept_optimization_if: cost OR latency paired delta is statistically significant (95% CI excluding 0) AND pass-rate delta is within the noise band measured by the variance probe

significance.pass_rate: McNemar's test on paired pass/fail, alpha=0.05
significance.cost_latency: paired per-task deltas, 95% CI via t-distribution; report delta with CI on every point estimate

decision_rule.kill_criteria_per_experiment: Each experiment E# gets a numeric kill criterion before running (see plans/plan.md subtask 7)

run_limits.n_concurrent_note: Must stay within Ada MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS (default 3); start at 2.
